newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end lower on political unrest.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end lower on political unrest.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended lower on Wednesday on selling pressure amid political unrest, including an opposition call for a countrywide strike on Thursday to protest against the killing of Prime Minister Benazir Bhutto's estranged brother Murtaza Bhutto, dealers said.
The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index ended 19.87 points, or 1.42 percent, lower at 1,383.32 amid 161 losers and 58 gainers in a turnover of 26 million shares, up from Tuesday's 23 million.
Political unrest and Moody's plans to downgrade Pakistan's credit rating set off bearish sentiment, one dealer said.
"The bearish sentiment continued throughout the day while there were still fears of major selling," dealer Ali Raza said.
HUBCO fell 1.00 to 31.50 rupees, PTCL 0.60 to 33, Fauji Fertilizer 0.80 to 69, Shell Pakistan 12 to 128, Engro Chemical 2.00 to 142 and Faysal Bank 0.35 to 20. Brooke Bond rose 2.00 to 165.
